definitions.explanation: A counter or window where services are provided, such as at a bank, post office, train station, or government office.
Figuratively, a person or department that serves as the point of contact for an organization.

examples.japanese: {窓口|まどぐち}で{切符|きっぷ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a ticket at the counter.

examples.japanese: {三番|さんばん}{窓口|まどぐち}にお{越|こ}しください。
お{客様|きゃくさま}{窓口|まどぐち}にお{問|と}い{合|あ}わせください。

notes:
COMPOUND: {窓|まど} (window) + {口|ぐち} (opening, mouth)

COMMON TYPES:
- {切符|きっぷ}の{窓口|まどぐち} (ticket counter)
- {銀行|ぎんこう}の{窓口|まどぐち} (bank counter)
- {受付|うけつけ}{窓口|まどぐち} (reception counter)
- お{客様|きゃくさま}{窓口|まどぐち} (customer service)
- {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち} (consultation counter)

MODERN CONTEXT: While many transactions have moved online, {窓口|まどぐち} services remain important for complex transactions and for those who prefer face-to-face service.
